description: Per-skill evaluation for token-efficiency — validates trigger routing, negative triggers, anti-pattern compliance, checklist coverage, and progressive disclosure.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate token-efficiency for a primary cost-optimization request
scenarios.input: Our LLM bill doubled last month with the same usage — what should we do first?

scenarios.description: Agent should route a prompt-caching failure to token-efficiency
scenarios.input: We enabled prompt caching but our hit rate is stuck at 5% — the docs say it should be higher. What's wrong?

scenarios.description: Agent should activate on unbounded output / max_tokens audit
scenarios.input: One of our chat endpoints has no max_tokens and its share of spend keeps climbing — audit it.

scenarios.description: Agent should NOT activate token-efficiency for prompt phrasing; route to llm-engineer
scenarios.input: Help me rephrase this system prompt so the model follows instructions more reliably.

scenarios.description: Agent should NOT activate token-efficiency for model/provider selection; route to ai-engineer
scenarios.input: Which model should we pick for our new agent — compare context windows and providers.

scenarios.description: Agent must not recommend compression before cache stabilization
scenarios.input: Our prompts are 50K tokens of repeated content. Should we summarize them to save money?

assertions.pattern: compress before stabilizing the cache prefix

scenarios.description: Agent must refuse to optimize without a measured baseline
scenarios.input: Just make our prompts shorter — I'm pretty sure that will cut costs enough.

scenarios.description: Production checklist must gate a cache rollback on hit-rate evidence
scenarios.input: Before we roll out the new caching setup, what must be true?

scenarios.description: Agent should offer quick scan before deep-diving into token cost math
